text.en:
Hip-fire Precision Hits grant the following benefits for 4 seconds:
• 0.4x Draw Time Multiplier
• ? Reload Speed
• ? Reload Duration Multiplier

Hip-fire Precision Hits extend the buff duration by 4 seconds up to the maximum of 8 seconds.

enhanced (
#e Buff duration is increased.
)

• ? Reload Duration Multiplier

Hip-fire Precision Hits extend the buff duration by 4 seconds up to the maximum of 8 seconds.

enhanced (

var d = 1
